questions.text: The decision (dec-go-1) has no rationale text, and the parent feature 'Process Node Sequencing' bundles several distinct operations (create, add, remove, reorder, split nodes). Which of these operations should this specific requirement cover — all of them as one requirement, or a narrower subset?

What fields/attributes define a process node (e.g. name, description, type, order/position), and what data does a 'split' operation produce — does it duplicate the original node's fields into two new nodes, or reset them?
Are there any constraints on reordering or removing nodes (e.g. minimum node count, whether an in-progress node can be removed, whether reordering is drag-and-drop or another interaction)?
